name: beat-the-bookie
description: Beat the Bookie — a Telegram-native World Cup fan game. Predict in-play markets against TxODDS' de-margined line; score is Closing-Line Value (did the sharp market later agree with you), not luck. On-chain leaderboard = an unfakeable football-IQ record. Built for the Superteam x TxODDS World Cup hackathon (Consumer & Fan Experiences track).
